description: This Java class defines a Fragment that manages user login status and interacts with Android's storage provider system, including UI menu options and shared preferences.

classes.name: StorageProviderFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that toggles user login status and notifies the system of storage root changes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment and reads login status.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the options menu, updating the login/logout menu item.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection, toggling login and notifying storage system.

methods.name: toggleLogin
methods.description: Switches login state and logs the action.

methods.name: writeLoginValue
methods.description: Saves login status to shared preferences.

methods.name: readLoginValue
methods.description: Retrieves login status from shared preferences.
